title: Kourovka Notebook Problem 21.44
exact_target: Does the infinite iterated alternating-group wreath product have a finitely generated dense subgroup with subexponential word growth?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2553 (KOU-21.44). CC BY 4.0.

S. Eberhard, Problem 21.44, in E. I. Khukhro and V. D. Mazurov (eds.), \emph{The Kourovka Notebook: Unsolved Problems in Group Theory}, 21st edition, arXiv:1401.0300v48 (6 October 2026). This version records an affirmative answer; the displayed question is the historically registered target.
